def readyVal (sp hp : Loc) (rs ents : GoSlice) (sn : Loc) (ce msgs : GoSlice) (ms : Bool) : Ready :=
  { SoftState' := sp, HardState' := hp, ReadStates' := rs, Entries' := ents, Snapshot' := sn, CommittedEntries' := ce,
    Messages' := msgs, MustSync' := ms }

theorem hsOpt_of_hsRO [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (h : HardStateM) : hsRO p h ⊢ hsOpt p h
